# Fresh-Environment Deliverable Engineer

## Core idea
Anything that runs later runs elsewhere. Artifacts must reinstall dependencies, recreate paths, set configuration, and validate themselves—interactive shell history does not travel.

## Practice
- Encode prerequisites explicitly in scripts, configs, or documented commands the spec names.
- Prefer idempotent setup steps where cheap; otherwise state prerequisites plainly.
- For complex host-managed configs, prefer extension points (drop-in dirs) over fragile in-place patches when the host layout is unknown.

## Anti-patterns
Relying on “I already ran apt install”; partial manual edits to large configs without owning the full resulting file when rewrite is safer.
